Priya (acct-cust): Hey team — customer on Dedicated reported the A/B dashboard shows the opposite split from their server logs. They claim 65% A / 35% B in our request logs, but Console shows ~70% B. Can someone triage?
Alex (support): Thanks Priya. Can you drop a sample request ID and a screenshot of the dashboard view? Also which project + env?
Priya (acct-cust): Project: acme-payments-prod, env: dedicated-us-west-2. Screenshot attached. Sample event ID: evt_01G7XH9L2Z. Copy of assignment event payload below:
```
{
  "user_id": "u_12345",
  "experiment": "checkout-banner-test",
  "variant": "A",
  "timestamp": 1719501001,
  "request_id": "evt_01G7XH9L2Z"
}
```
Alex (support): Got it. @Sam can you peek at the ingestion / mapping for that experiment? Maybe variant keys getting remapped?
Sam (eng-analytics): Looking now. I see recent deploy from yesterday that changed the analytics mapping: the ingestion lambda started preferring `variant_id` over `variant` for normalization. If incoming payloads still use `variant`, we should fall back, but the fallback looks broken for experiments created pre-migration.
Jordan (eng-product): We rolled a small change to canonicalize variant labels (lowercase + strip prefixes) to unify naming. Could that have flipped label interpretation?
Sam (eng-analytics): Possibly. The aggregation query in the Console groups on `normalized_variant` which is populated by the mapper. For this experiment I see mapper produced values: for incoming `"variant": "A"` -> normalized `"B"` due to a bad regex in the normalization step. Looks like we accidentally matched `^A(-.*)?` -> replace with `B` in the rule set.
Maya (oncall): @Sam can you paste the mapper rule or the offending regex? If it's a simple replacement we can patch quickly or disable normalization.
Sam (eng-analytics): Pasted snippet:
```
// pseudo-rule from yesterday's deploy
normalized = variant.replace(/^(A|B)-prefix/, (m) => mapping[m] || m);
// but mapping contains an accidental mapping: {"A": "B"}
```
That explains swapped labels for historical experiments where `variant` was exactly `A` or `B`.
Jordan (eng-product): Ugh. That mapping came from the rollout-config migration we pushed. We updated a CSV -> JSON transform; an entry was mis-keyed.
Alex (support): Short term mitigation for customer: we can surface raw counts (group by raw `variant` field) in the dashboard or run a quick SQL to recompute counts from raw events. Priya can you run a manual check and confirm?
Priya (acct-cust): I can provide raw logs but would prefer Redwood to verify since customer analytics used Console as single source of truth.
Sam (eng-analytics): I'll run a recompute job on `acme-payments-prod` for `checkout-banner-test` for the timeframe 2024-06-01 -> 2024-06-30 and compare.
rollout-bot: [deploy] analytics-mapper v2.3.7 promoted by jordan at 2024-06-26T21:03:11Z
Sam (eng-analytics): Confirmed: recomputed counts from raw events -> A: 64.8%, B: 35.2%. Console showed A: 29.1% B: 70.9% due to normalized field.
Maya (oncall): Immediate action: revert the normalization update in mapper to v2.3.6 and run a hotfix to remove the incorrect mapping entry. I'll open a rollback PR and trigger.
Jordan (eng-product): I'll own the PR and validation. Also preparing a one-off migration to re-run normalization on historical data to restore normalized_variant = raw_variant for affected experiments.
Alex (support): ETA on rollback? Priya needs ETA to give the customer.
Maya (oncall): Rolling back now, will monitor metrics pipeline. Estimated 20–30m to revert and replay small batch of recent events.
Sam (eng-analytics): After rollback I will run aggregation again and post verification screenshots.
Alex (support): Priya — we will follow up with corrected dashboard screenshots and a short RCA. Can you confirm the customer is paused on any decisions pending dashboard numbers?
Priya (acct-cust): They paused triggering the larger rollout. Please prioritize — they rely on Console for automatic traffic shifts.
Sam (eng-analytics): Rollback merged, mapper service restarted. Re-aggregating last 48h for that experiment.
Sam (eng-analytics): Recompute done. Console now shows A: 65.1% B: 34.9% — matches server logs within sampling.
Alex (support): Marking this resolved for the customer. We'll draft an RCA: cause = bad mapping entry during rollout-config migration; impact = swapped normalized_variant for some experiments; fix = rollback + migration + added unit test on mapping import.
Jordan (eng-product): I'll add a guard: reject mapping entries where key == value_swap or run a diff against raw_variant before applying.
Priya (acct-cust): Thanks all. Customer is unpaused and will proceed with canary. Appreciate the quick triage. :heart:
Alex (support): Closing thread but will attach RCA doc and PR links. If anything reappears reopen. :thumbsup:
